description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a flagship scheme launched by the Government of India in May 2020. 

The scheme aims to enhance fish production and productivity in the country. 

It focuses on the sustainable development of the fisheries sector. 

The PMMSY is designed to promote the growth of the fisheries sector through various initiatives. 

One of the specific components of PMMSY is the Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative in Haryana. 

This initiative was introduced to support fishers and fish farmers in the state. 

The Cycle with Ice Boxes scheme aims to provide a means of transportation for fishers. 

It enables them to transport their catch while maintaining the quality and freshness of the fish. 

The objective of this initiative is to reduce post-harvest losses in fish. 

The scheme also aims to increase the income of fishers by ensuring better market access. 

The initiative provides fishers with cycles that are equipped with ice boxes. 

These ice boxes help in preserving the fish during transportation. 

The cycles are designed to be user-friendly and efficient for local transportation needs. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

Each beneficiary is eligible for a subsidy of up to INR 10,000. 

This subsidy is aimed at covering a significant portion of the cost of the cycle and ice box. 

The total cost of the cycle with ice box is approximately INR 15,000. 

Therefore, the beneficiaries need to contribute around INR 5,000 from their own resources. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined. 

Beneficiaries must be registered fishers or fish farmers in Haryana. 

They should possess a valid fishing license issued by the state government. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility. 

The income criteria for eligibility is also defined. 

Applicants must have an annual income of less than INR 2 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process for the Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must visit the official website of the Fisheries Department of Haryana. 

They can download the application form from the website. 

The application form must be filled out completely with accurate details. 

Applicants are required to submit the form along with necessary documents. 

These documents include a copy of the fishing license. 

They must also provide proof of identity and address. 

Additionally, a recent passport-sized photograph is required. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the local Fisheries Department office. 

The application will be reviewed by the officials. 

If approved, the subsidy amount will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The timeline for the entire application process can vary. 

However, beneficiaries can expect a response within 30 to 45 days of submission. 

The disbursement of the subsidy is typically done in a single installment. 

This ensures that beneficiaries can quickly procure the cycle and ice box. 

The implementing authority for this initiative is the Fisheries Department of Haryana. 

They are responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

The department also conducts awareness programs to educate fishers about the scheme. 

Contact details for the Fisheries Department can be found on their official website. 

They provide a helpline for beneficiaries to inquire about the scheme. 

The PMMSY Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative is part of a larger effort to boost the fisheries sector in India. 

The overall PMMSY scheme has a financial outlay of INR 20,050 crore. 

It aims to increase fish production to 220 lakh metric tons by 2024-25. 

The scheme also focuses on creating employment opportunities in the fisheries sector. 

It aims to generate approximately 55 lakh direct and indirect jobs. 

The Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative specifically targets the needs of local fishers. 

It addresses the challenges they face in transporting their catch. 

By providing financial assistance for transportation, the scheme enhances their livelihood. 

The initiative is expected to significantly reduce post-harvest losses. 

This is crucial for improving the overall profitability of fish farming. 

The scheme also aligns with the government's vision of doubling farmers' income by 2022. 

The Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative is a step towards achieving this goal. 

It empowers fishers with better tools for their trade. 

The initiative is expected to improve the quality of fish available in the market. 

This, in turn, benefits consumers and enhances food security. 

The PMMSY Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative is a prime example of targeted welfare schemes. 

It demonstrates the government's commitment to supporting the fisheries sector. 

The scheme reflects the importance of sustainable practices in fish production. 

Overall, the initiative is a significant move towards enhancing the livelihoods of fishers in Haryana. 

It provides them with the necessary resources to thrive in a competitive market. 

The Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative is a vital component of the broader PMMSY framework. 

It showcases the government's proactive approach to addressing the needs of the fisheries community. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the livelihoods of fishers in Haryana. 

It is a crucial step towards building a robust fisheries sector in the state. 

The successful implementation of this initiative can serve as a model for other states. 

It highlights the importance of providing targeted support to vulnerable communities. 

The PMMSY Cycle with Ice Boxes initiative stands as a testament to the government's efforts. 

It aims to uplift the fisheries sector and improve the economic conditions of fishers.
